title: RenderPacket
description: Bounded model-facing memory output. RenderPackets are the only model-facing boundary in the BrainCase memory plane. Raw StateRecords are internal until rendered. A RenderPacket must stay within one memory_domain unless future explicit cross-domain policy exists. It must be bounded by a token budget and must cite source record IDs rather than dumping raw storage.

packet_id.description: Unique identifier for this render packet.

purpose.description: What this packet is for, e.g. 'task_continuity', 'project_constraints', 'open_loops'. Drives what the renderer selects.

memory_domain.description: Configured isolation domain this packet was rendered from. Must not mix domains. This is the configured value — the schema does not define or grant domain values.

generated_at_ms.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this packet was generated.

budget_tokens.description: Maximum token budget allocated to this packet.

rendered_text.description: The bounded model-facing text content. Must not exceed budget_tokens when tokenized. This is the only model-visible content in the BrainCase memory plane.

source_record_ids.description: record_ids of the StateRecords whose content contributed to this packet.

omitted_count.description: Number of candidate records that were omitted due to budget constraints or redaction.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings from the render process, e.g. budget pressure, low-confidence records, redacted items.
